parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The details of the filter condition.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the returned page. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the HaVip.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the HaVip belongs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-ha-vips --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --filter '[{"Value":["Active"],"Key":"HaVipId"}]' --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000 --tags Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc DescribeHaVips --region cn-hangzhou --Tags.1.Value FinanceJoshua --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000' --PageNumber 1 --Filter.1.Value.1 Active --Tags.1.Key FinanceDept --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Filter.1.Key HaVipId
